summary: Verified aktif/stok business rules against live Google Sheet catalog. Backend correctly excludes row 10 Minyak Goreng (aktif=FALSE) from GET /api/products and returns 404 on /api/products/10. Unit test on _parse_csv confirms aktif=TRUE + stok=0 rows ARE kept (Habis scenario). ProductCard.jsx renders badge-habis and disabled add-disabled button when stok<=0 (code-reviewed). Frontend /produk shows only 9 active products (IDs 1-9), no Minyak Goreng anywhere, search 'minyak' returns 0 results, search 'bayam' returns 1. All 4 pytest cases pass.
action_items: Optional: to visually validate the Habis badge/disabled button end-to-end, ask user to set aktif=TRUE and stok=0 for one row in the Google Sheet (e.g. keep Minyak Goreng active with stok=0). Currently the sheet has NO row with aktif=TRUE+stok=0, so the on-site 'Habis' state is only verified via unit test + code review, not a live screenshot.
critical_code_review_comments: product_service._parse_csv line 98: correct — filters aktif=FALSE only; stok=0 rows pass through with aktif=True.
ProductCard.jsx lines 41-71: correct dual-state rendering — badge-habis + Stok Habis disabled button when product.stok<=0. data-testid present on both.

Product cache TTL 300s: after Sheet edits, users may need up to 5 min or must call GET /api/products?refresh=true; UI has no explicit refresh trigger. Consider surfacing this or lowering TTL for content edits.
